answer: In this PoA design, every identity posts bonded collateral in an escrow, so coordinated equivocation by k identities produces correlated evidence and penalties scaling as O(k^2), rather than linearly. Once detected, a sybil swarm triggers an exponential multiplier on capital loss across linked escrows, compounded by asymmetric depreciation of tainted stake. Splitting control therefore cannot evade accountability: aliases named lagoon, saffron, or wander remain economically coupled.
